tcs.tc_title: Buffer playlist can be browsed and an entry selected
tcs.test_item: The Buffer playlist shall be browseable with the functions defined in CFTS024-193, CFTS024-195 and CFTS024-197
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The buffer holds more songs than the playlist displays on one screen
5. Playback is positioned inside the buffer
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the buffer playlist
2. Operate the browse controls to move through the list beyond the first screen
3. Read the entries displayed after browsing
4. Select one entry from the list and read the content played
tcs.expected_result:
1. The buffer playlist is displayed
2. The list responds to the browse controls, as defined by CFTS024-193, CFTS024-195 and CFTS024-197
3. Entries that were not on the first screen are displayed
4. Playback moves to the buffered content of the selected entry
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
